1 # Sprint 14 — InkOS Visual Redesign Spec 2 3 **Author:** Vega | **Date:** 2026-04-15 | **Stack:** Stack A (Next 16 + shadcn/Tailwind 4) 4 5 **Context:** 13 sprints built, 66 DB tables, 286 components. The product is functionally complete but visually reads as "developer scaffold with purple." DaySmart/Porter look like 2018 enterprise software. InkOS must look like 2026: a dark-first, niche-specific, premium tool that a tattoo studio owner would screenshot and share. This spec drives every CSS and component change needed to achieve that. 6 7 --- 8 9 ## 1. DIAGNOSIS — WHY IT READS AS GENERIC 10 11 Current issues (all fixable without touching logic): 12 13 1. **Background is too black without texture.** `oklch(9% 0.015 264)` is pure near-black. No depth. No differentiation between hierarchy layers. Every surface blends into every other surface. 14 2. **Cards are barely distinguishable from the page.** `card: oklch(12% 0.015 264)` on `background: oklch(9% 0.015 264)` is only 3 lightness points apart. No visual lift. 15 3. **Primary purple is correct but underused.** It appears on active sidebar items and borders but never as a statement. No gradients, no glow accents, no layered use. 16 4. **Sidebar feels like default shadcn.** Standard `SidebarMenuButton` hover states, no ink/studio character, group labels feel like any enterprise tool. 17 5. **Auth pages are centered-form-on-gradient.** Correct brand color is used but 0.15 opacity is too subtle. No visual statement, no trust signals, no tattoo-niche context. 18 6. **KPI cards have a left border but no depth.** `border-l-2 border-l-primary` is a common SaaS pattern. Needs elevation contrast to feel premium. 19 7. **Empty states are functional but lifeless.** `rounded-xl bg-primary/10 p-4` icon container with centered text is the Notion/shadcn default — recognizable as a scaffold. 20 8. **Typography hierarchy is flat.** Page titles at `text-2xl font-bold` but supporting content at the same color as primary content (`text-foreground`). No contrast gradient from hero → body → caption. 21 9. **PageHeader left-border accent** (`border-l-2 border-primary pl-3`) is the right instinct but the border is too thin and doesn't animate or glow. 22 10. **FullCalendar** retains its default styling; custom CSS variables are defined but the toolbar/event cards still feel like a plugin, not a native part of the app. 23 24 --- 25 26 ## 2.
